historical_hotspots_note: The DEA product description points at a historic archive under https://hotspots.dea.ga.gov.au/files/historic (all-data-csv.zip and related files) and at WFS. On 13 November 2026, WFS GetCapabilities listed only recent layers (public:hotspots, public:hotspots_three_days, satellite-pass layers). GetFeature requests returned no bytes before timing out. The advertised zip URLs returned the website HTML shell (about 12 KB), not an archive. The public ga-sentinel bucket listing contains raw satellite granules, not the hotspot table. Historical fire activity in this project is therefore the fire-weather record. Satellite heat is the recent feed only.
